remarks: Excellent FIRST HOME or INVESTOR special!!! Meticulous and lovingly maintained fully updated 1BR TOP FLOOR condo in the Shippan Neighborhood of Stamford. Beautiful updated kitchen cabinets and countertops, stainless steel appliances, washer/dryer combo in the unit, great size bedroom with three closets including built-in closet shelves. NEW wall unit in the living room. Boiler is 1 YR old. Roof is 1.5 YR OLD. Windows in the living room have been replaced six months ago. The entire unit was freshly painted and the storm doors replaced six months ago. This lovely condo with beautiful city views is on the 2nd floor of a well maintained building just steps to shopping and restaurants, walkable to beaches and Cummings and West Beach parks for the baseball, soccer, tennis and boating/beach enthusiasts. Minutes to Chelsea Piers, I-95, Downtown Stamford... 1 car dedicated CARPORT parking spot and additional parking on the street if desired. What does this amazing condo not have? Grab it while you can. The retaining wall was repaired and there are no special assessments. No pet or rental restrictions!!!
